title: Best MCP Servers for Claude Code in 2026 (Tested and Ranked)
summary: The 10 best MCP servers for Claude Code — ranked by usefulness, install speed, and real Claude Code compatibility. Blink, GitHub, Playwright, and more.
body_markdown: The modelcontextprotocol/servers repo is Anthropic's reference implementation — correct, well-tested, and actively maintained. They are safe to use. "Not production-hardened" means they are not optimized for high-volume or high-concurrency scenarios — they are designed to be correct and educational, not to handle thousands of concurrent requests. For a typical developer workflow, they are fine. For a production service that many users hit simultaneously, use your provider's official server instead.
